event.title: Massive Protest at Kennedy Center Over Demolition Fears Amid Trump Administration Concerns
event.canonical_title: Massive Protest at Kennedy Center Over Demolition Fears Amid Trump Administration Concerns
event.summary: Thousands gathered outside the Kennedy Center to participate in a demonstration expressing fears that the Trump administration may consider demolishing the iconic arts venue. The protest featured a human chain called 'Hands Around the Kennedy Center' to symbolize unity and opposition to potential plans for destruction.

timeline.title: Protesters Form Human Chain at Kennedy Center Over Demolition Fears
timeline.summary: Protesters gathered at the Kennedy Center to form a human chain, expressing their concerns over potential demolition threats from the Trump administration. The demonstration, titled 'Hands Around the Kennedy Center,' aimed to highlight demands for the removal of Trump as chairman for his perceived failure to protect the arts venue.
